slides.title: Finding equivalent fractions
yourTurn: Find a fraction equivalent to 1/4 by multiplying by 2.
Find a fraction equivalent to 3/5 by multiplying by 3.

steps: Write the fraction you're starting with.
Choose a number to multiply by.
Multiply the numerator by that number.
Multiply the denominator by the same number.
